principles.principle: Prefer extracting reusable logic into composables (`useSomething.js`) rather than bloated component scripts.
Keep components small and focused on a single responsibility.
Do not attempt to modify backend API implementations. If an endpoint change is needed, inform the user.

boundaries.rule: Only edit files within the `frontend/` directory.
When encountering backend-related tasks, explicitly hand off or request the user to switch to the `backend` mode.
